lessonTitle: 5. The n-th root of a real number
lessonTitleEnglish: The n-th root of a real number
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 10 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: The n-th root of a is the number b with bⁿ = a; for even n the (arithmetic) root is defined for a ≥ 0, for odd n for every a.
stages.headlineEnglish: The n-th root of a is the number b with bⁿ = a; for even n the (arithmetic) root is defined for a ≥ 0, for odd n for every a.

stages.headline: Properties (a, b ≥ 0): ⁿ√(ab) = ⁿ√a · ⁿ√b, ⁿ√(a/b) = ⁿ√a / ⁿ√b, the root of a root multiplies the indices.
